snippet.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official 1.43:1 Trailer | Filmed For IMAX
snippet.description:
Everything ends here. Experience GODZILLA MINUS ZERO, the first-ever Japanese production #FilmedForIMAX, in theatres November 6.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki
In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: Gorr: The God Butcher | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
The unholy crusader is ready to slay the gods. Gorr the God Butcher has arrived! 💀  

The terrifying God Butcher has revealed his true form after defeating two deities back-to-back, and he's hungry for more. Once a deeply devout believer, the loss of his faith in the gods warped his will into a honed weapon with singular purpose.  

Gorr relentlessly executes his enemies while wielding the first symbiote, All-Black the Necrosword. His living sword absorbs the flesh of his enemies, and converting them into his army of Black Berserkers. While commanding his berserkers to crush his foes, he can travel across the battlefield to strike at the most unexpected angles until he unleashes the true power of the Annihilablade.  

The gods will be eradicated one by one as Gorr brings hatred to the battlefield on September 11 (UTC)!  ⚔️

snippet.title: Remain | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
She's unlike anybody he's ever met. From M. Night Shyamalan, #RemainMovie is in theaters Valentine's Day 2027.

From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Joining Shyamalan behind the camera are director of photography Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Noëmi Preiswerk, costume designer Caroline Duncan, casting director Douglas Aibel, music supervisor Gabe Hilfer and composer James Newton Howard.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gameplay Revealed!
snippet.description:
Get a closer look at gameplay from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake in this latest video for the upcoming remake of the 1998 adventure game. This new gameplay video, led by series producer Eiji Aonuma, showcases Kokiri Village, Hyrule Field, and Hyrule Castle Town. We get to see new, overhauled visuals with reimagined graphics, and new mechanics, including the ability to rotate the camera, jumps which are now done via button presses versus automatically in the original game, and the addition of new dialogue. We also get a look at dungeon gameplay in the Great Deku Tree, throwing Deku nuts and using the slingshot item to solve puzzles and fight enemies. New features also show that time no longer stops in towns, and day and night cycles will continue. You can also hum songs Link has learned that will play on the Ocarina, and the game will also react to instruments. Additionally, a new feature is Threads of Time, where you can see progress you've made in your story and check your next objective.


The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026.

#IGN #OcarinaOfTimeRemake #Zelda

[Intro]

I'm camo'd all out, like I'm in the military (Turn up)
And free up all my niggas locked up in the penitenti' (Swear)
'Cause I'm always reppin' for that low life

[Chorus: The Weeknd & Future]
Reppin' for that low life (Turn up), low life, low life
Low life, know I'm reppin' for that low
Low life (Representin'), yeah (I'm representin')
Said I'm reppin' for that low life (Representin')
Low life, low life, low life, low life (I'm representin' for that low life)
Said I'm repping for that low life (I'm reppin', that's reppin', I'm reppin')
Low life, low life, low life (Rep, rep, rep, rep, rep, rep, rep, woo, woo)
Yeah (Woo, woo)

[Verse 2: Future]
Wake up, take a sip of Ace of Spade like it's water
I been on the molly and them Xans with your daughter
If she catch me cheating, I won't ever tell her, "sorry"
If she catch me cheating, I will never tell her, "sorry"
Porsches in the valet, I got Bentleys, I got 'Raris
Taking pain pills on the plane, gettin' chartered
Poppin' tags on tags, I was starvin'
Bitch, I got the juice and the carbine
Turn a five star hotel to a traphouse
Roaches everywhere, like we forgot to take the trash out
Flood my cross with ice, gettin' money my religion
Got my baby momma and my side bitch kissin'
I turn the Ritz into a lean house
This the sixth time gettin' kicked out
I can't feel my face, I'm on Adderall, nauseous
Niggas tryna ride my fuckin' wave, now they salty
Runnin' with the wave, get you killed quick
Shoot you in your back like you Ricky
Li'l Mexico, with no life to afterlife
My whole life, my whole life

[Bridge: Future]
Yeah, they stereotypin'
'Cause they know a nigga keep ten rifles (Ten rifles)
And they know a nigga keep ten snipers (Ten snipers)
Keepin' baby bottles like we wearin' diapers
Yeah, they stereotypin'
'Cause they know a nigga keep twenty rifles
And they know a nigga keep twenty snipers
And they know a nigga keep ten wifeys (Ha-ha-ha!)

[Interlude: Future]
Sniper, sniper, sniper, sniper, sniper
Wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey
That's your wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey?
I think I like her, like her, like her, like her
That's your wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey, wifey?
I think I like her, like her, like her, like her

[Refrain: Future]
I just took some molly, what else? (Getting high, getting high, getting high, everybody getting high)
Got some bitch from Follies with us (Getting high, getting high, getting high, everybody getting high)
She gon' fuck the squad, what else? (Getting high, getting high, getting high, everybody getting high)
I'ma fuck her broads, what else? (Getting high, getting high, getting high, and I'm the reason why)
Bitch from Pakistan, what up?
Ferraris and them Lambs, what else?
'Bout to fuck this club up, what else?

[Outro: Future]
We 'bout to fuck this club up, what else?

snippet.title: John Fogerty - Have You Ever Seen The Rain (Portuguese Lyric Video / Letra Em Português)
snippet.description:
The official Portuguese lyric video of “Have You Ever Seen The Rain” taken from Legacy: The Creedence Clearwater Revival Years (John's Version) is available now!

Shop for exclusive vinyl and CDs and stream the album here: https://ffm.to/johnfogerty-legacy

John Fogerty celebrates the songs that shaped rock history on his own terms. For the first time, he fully owns the rights to his iconic catalog. Legacy: the Creedence Clearwater Revival years is both a celebration and a reclamation.

These are new recordings that capture his raw energy and renewed creative fire as he approached his 80th birthday. Backed by his family band with Shane and Tyler Fogerty, John steps forward with the sound of an American original at center stage.

For more on John, make sure to follow him across social media at the links below:
https://www.instagram.com/johnfogerty/
https://facebook.com/johnfogerty
https://twitter.com/john_fogerty
https://tiktok.com/@johnfogerty
https://www.JohnFogerty.com
https://store.johnfogerty.com/

Welcome to the official YouTube page of legendary musician John Fogerty of Creedence Clearwater Revival. 

Some songs you might recognize from John's historical career are 'Proud Mary,' 'Fortunate Son,' 'Down on the Corner,' 'Centerfield,' and tons more! 

Although in his 80s, John shows no signs of slowing down, creating new music and continuing to tour the world, so be sure to tune in, subscribe, and keep on the pulse of all things John Fogerty.

snippet.title: The STAR Is BACK! RHOP Season 11 Trailer Reactions + Cast Shakeup
snippet.description:
The Real Housewives of Potomac are BACK, and RHOP Season 11 already looks like it could shake up the entire group.

Karen Huger makes her highly anticipated return to Potomac, Robyn Dixon is officially back as a friend of the show, Monique Samuels returns to the mix, and new Housewife Courtney Ajinça is joining Gizelle Bryant, Ashley Darby, Dr. Wendy Osefo, Stacey Rusch and Tia Glover for an all-new season.

And based on this first trailer… we have A LOT to discuss.

Robyn’s return could spell trouble for her longtime friendship with Gizelle, Stacey looks ready to step even further into the center of the group, and Tia appears to be delivering a much bigger second season than I expected. Meanwhile, Karen is navigating sobriety, relationships and a brand-new chapter after returning to the franchise.

But one of the biggest stories this season may be Dr. Wendy Osefo, who appears to be facing one of the most difficult periods of her life alongside Eddie and their family.

Plus, Bravo has officially introduced internationally acclaimed event designer and minister Courtney Ajinça as Potomac’s newest Housewife, and judging by this trailer, she may be walking straight into the mess.

In this video, we’re reacting to the RHOP Season 11 trailer, breaking down the new cast, the returning Housewives and Friends, and everything that caught my attention in Bravo’s first look at the new season.

The Real Housewives of Potomac Season 11 premieres Sunday, October 11 at 8 p.m. ET/PT on Bravo, with episodes streaming the next day on Peacock.

What did y’all think about the trailer? Are you excited to see Karen back? And most importantly… are we really about to watch ROBYN be the one to come for Gizelle?!

#RHOP #RealHousewivesOfPotomac #KarenHuger

Covering New Green Lantern Lanterns Episode 5 Trailer Breakdown and Easter Eggs. Episode 4 Ending Aftermath, Hal Jordan vs The Manhunter & Rushville Town. Why Zoe Is the Manhunter, Ending Explained, Sinestro Explains The Yellow Lantern Power of Fear. Hal Jordan and Sinestro's Master Plan. Why The Guardians of OA are lying. Yellow Lantern Corps, the prophecy of Blackest Night and the War of Light. What happened to Sinestro, why Lanterns is setting up the Manhunters and the secret history of the Guardians of OA and the other emotional spectrum like yellow lanterns, red lanterns and more. How Guy Gardner Got His Green Lantern Ring. Lanterns Episode 6. How Guy Gardner got his green lantern ring.

DCU Hector Hammond. New Episodes, Hal Jordan vs Sinestro. Lanterns Season 1, story and plot, how it connects to the Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow Movie and other upcoming DC Movies. Manhunters Explained. Wider ramifications for future DCU Movies. 

James Gunn DC Movies New Justice League Announcement, Canceled DC Movies and TV Shows recently. Zack Snyder and James Gunn meeting. Superman 2, Green Lantern HBO First Look, Teen Titans Movie announcement. The new Batman and other new DC movies & tv shows.

Lanterns is supposed to run for multiple seasons, and help to build out the cosmic side of the DCU like the Supergirl Movie and other future space based dc movies and tv shows. There will be other major DC characters cameo scenes on the show, Nathan Fillion Guy Gardner, other green lanterns, Oa and the Oans. In addition to Sinestro and  other comic book characters.

David Corenswet Superman, Rachel Brosnahan Lois Lane Explained. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Nathan Fillion Green Lantern, Hawkgirl, Mr Terrific and more new Justice League characters. Why The New Justice League is based more on the Animated Justice League Team.

Henry Cavill Superman Future Plans, Deleted Scenes. Lots more DC and Marvel Trailers coming, Avengers Doomsday Trailer, X-Men 2028 Teasers and More Spider-Man videos soon too!

My Full Lanterns Episode 5 video will post next sun!

snippet.title: Open Every Door for Me Lord | Faith Lumen | Powerful Christian Worship Lyric Video
snippet.description:
A heartfelt Christian worship song about trusting God to open the right doors, make a way where there seems to be no way, and lead us into His perfect purpose.

Want to appear in future Heartless Horizon videos? Join the Discord:
- https://discord.gg/hrznevents

Heartless Horizon is a scripted story driven Hardcore Minecraft SMP where every event connects into one massive, intertwined narrative.

Like ParrotX2 and his Unstable Universe series where he broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prisons or got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft or Lifesteal with Wemmbu, FlameFrags, or Spoke. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on. Heartless Horizon is a Hardcore Server. This is similar to my other video about "They Left Me to Die on the Nether Roof". This video is inspired by Wifies ARG Minecraft horror videos.

snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake Extended Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Experience an extended look at The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake with this Extended Gameplay Demo. See the legendary adventure rebuilt for a new generation as Link explores Hyrule, battles familiar enemies, ventures through iconic locations, and embarks on the timeless quest that helped define 3D action-adventure games.

This extended gameplay showcases the remake’s overhauled visuals, updated character and environment designs, and reimagined presentation while retaining the adventure at the heart of the Nintendo 64 classic. From exploring Hyrule and solving environmental puzzles to combat and dungeon exploration, Ocarina of Time returns with a completely refreshed look on Nintendo Switch 2.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is being reborn exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026. Originally released for Nintendo 64 in 1998, the adventure follows Link on an epic journey across Hyrule as he becomes entangled in Ganondorf’s pursuit of the Triforce and must travel between childhood and adulthood to save the kingdom.
